title: Unit Event — Perspective for Smile — Episode2 The Role in Her Hands

meta.Episode: Episode2 — The Role in Her Hands
meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime has finished training with Shunmeiza, and is set to study stage combat with the Mikazukigumi troupe. How will Emu and the others fare on this new, intensely physical stage?!

rows.Line: Mikazukigumi Practice Area

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, this place is huge...!
It's like a big gym!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So this is where Mikazukigumi practices.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Yeah, but we rent this place out.
We don't actually own it or anything.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
We are a small troupe, after all.
Shunmeiza has their own theatre, while we find venues to rent for each of our performances.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: And as far as troupe members go, this is just about all of our actors.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Listen up, everyone!
Wonderlands×Showtime has come to visit us!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We're Wonderlands×Showtime.
We look forward to working with you all starting today!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Rui & Nene
rows.Line: We look forward to working with you!

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
Oh, you guys are here!
We know your stay with us is gonna be short, but we're also really looking forward to working with you all!

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: You guys have been training with other troupes, right? That's so cool! You gotta tell us all about what you've been doing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Everyone here seems very friendly...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Yeah, they're a cheery bunch!
Just relax and be yourselves. There's no need to feel nervous.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh... O-Okay! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This is a totally different troupe compared to Shunmeiza...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's great how no two troupes are alike!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll have everyone introduce themselves a little later. For now, I'd like to discuss what you'll be doing with us...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: During your month with us, I'll be asking you to work with the goal of becoming a part of one of our productions.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A whole month?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: That's right. We're currently in the middle of getting our next production together...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: However, we still haven't decided what show to put on, let alone assigned any roles.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: So, depending on what your acting is like after one month with us... I'll be deciding whether to make you all an offer to be a part of it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
You'll be judging our skills based on our performance one month from now.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Exactly.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (So, he's testing us...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Then...
Whether or not we get to be a part of their next production completely depends on how we act a month from now...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(I wanna be in it!
The others also have to be thinking the same thing!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (So, we all gotta do our absolute best to perform well...!)

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Obviously, we're here to help you, so we're not going to just toss you out onto the street if things don't go well.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: But being included in our production is a different story.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Our goal is always to give our audience the best performances we possibly can. That isn't about to change, and I hope you'll all understand.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Good! Then, here's the script I want you to work with.
You guys choose which roles you want to play. We'll fill in the rest.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Once you've had a chance to read through it, a few of our members will lecture you on the basics of sword fighting and the sequences for this play.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Finally, at the end of today's practice, I'll have you all run the various climax scenes for each character.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I know I'm asking a lot, but I'm looking forward to seeing some good results...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Of course!
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! This story's so good...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I agree!
A pleasant surprise since I was expecting a much more serious historical drama!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me as well. I guess it just goes to show that it's hard to miss with Ushiwakamaru.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ushiwakamaru's real name was Minamoto no Yoshitsune, right...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, Ushiwakamaru was his name in childhood. The story of his life is a dramatic one that's constantly being told and retold even to this day.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And the story in this script is an adaptation of his legend.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The parts where he and the tengu jump around those mountains, and the way he defeated big ol' Benkei was so awesome!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! The little guy winning against overwhelming odds... A timeless tale of heroism that everyone loves.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, who's gonna play who?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Good question...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I think Emu should play Ushiwakamaru.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: W-Wait, you want me to be the lead...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I believe you'll have the easiest time out of all of us achieving a good grasp of Ushiwakamaru.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
To be honest, this Ushiwakamaru's kinda tricky because he's such a free spirit. I had a hard time understanding what he was thinking most of the time...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it's obvious that he likes to have fun and lives true to himself, which are traits that you both share, Emu. You probably won't have any trouble playing him.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You think so...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But are you sure...?
I thought either you or Tsukasa would've wanted to play the protagonist...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes... I obviously would like to play him.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I have to think that there's a reason behind you making this suggestion, Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There is. Whether or not we get to be a part of this troupe's next production hangs on how this play goes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, it presents us with a new type of challenge.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You mean the sword fighting...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If so, I feel the same in terms of assigning roles based on compatibility.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The last thing I want is to put on a half-baked performance because I had to frantically juggle acting and sword fighting.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...
Fair point.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Failure is not an option, and your suggestion may be our best one.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Tsukasa, but I'd like to assign roles in a way which more or less guarantees high-quality performances.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Especially since getting to work on a production with the other members of Mikazukigumi would invariably lead to many learning opportunities for us. I hope you understand.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well...
I agree with what you both just said.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Chasing two hares at once is bound to end in failure, which I'd like to avoid. And I'm sure Emu will do a magnificent job as the lead.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ushiwakamaru is in your hands, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You can count on me!
I promise to shine as the coolest Ushiwakamaru ever!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we'll be looking forward to that!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Then, let's begin assigning our other roles...
Starting with Benkei...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I get to play the lead...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'm sure Tsukasa and Nene both really wanted to instead...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(But they were willing to let me do it.
They think that'll make for the best performance.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (That means I've gotta do my absolute best!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (We're gonna make this play a big success...!)
